newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar closes strong on corporate buying.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar closes strong on corporate buying.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar closed stronger at C$1.3335 (US$0.7499) on Friday from Thursday's close at C$1.3380 (US$0.7474), the strongest the unit has been since October 6, 1995. * Dealers said the currency rallied on strong U.S. corporate interest to buy Canadian dollars, strong Canadian fundamentals and renewed interest in Canada's bond market.
Traders said investors are keen on the Canadian dollar now that they believe the U.S. Federal Reserve will not raise interest rates in the near future.
A rise in U.S. rates during a period of declining Canadian rates would widen the spread between the Canadian and U.S. rates and put pressure on the Canadian dollar.
Traders expected the rally to continue on Monday.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar dropped to 1.1328 marks from 1.1343 marks at the close on Thursday, and edged down to 84.94 yen from Thursday's 85.14 yen.
